title: LA Colossal – Khokhloma 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Polish woman in her early 20s, platinum-blonde chin-length bob, natural face with a playful smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the stool, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Khokhloma lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Glossy gold base with bold black and red strawberries, currants, and kudrina swirls. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated upright on a painted wooden stool, torso facing the camera, legs crossed at the knee, both hands resting lightly on her upper knee with elbows relaxed out. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch gold lacquer platform stiletto sandals with red ribbon laces wrapping up the calf and tied in a bow below the knee.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, red with gold leaf.

Background & Lighting: Russian dacha parlor with lace curtains and a samovar, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft window light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
